THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labourwhich accompanies this order exists between –
Union of Magampura Port, Magam Ruhunupura Mahinda Rajapaksha Port, Mirijjawila, Hambantota of the one part
01. Sri Lanka Ports Authority, No. 19, Chaithya Road, Colombo 0102. Magampura Port Management Company (Pvt.) Limited, 10th Floor, “Sayurupaya”, Mirijjawila, Hambantota of theother part

NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and SabaragamuwaDevelopment do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of theLegislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (readwith Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. S. Virithamulla, No. 128, Piriwena Road,Boralesgamuwa to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relationsand Sabaragamuwa Development.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Union of Magampura Port, Magam Ruhunupura Mahinda Rajapaksha Port, Mirijjawila, Hambantota of the one part
01.Sri Lanka Ports Authority, No. 19, Chaithya Road, Colombo 0102.Magampura Port Management Company (Pvt.) Limited, 10th Floor, “Sayurupaya”, Mirijjawila, Hambantota of theother part
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether the 458 employees of the Magampura Port inclusive of Mr. P. D. Sajith Saranga and Mr. J. B. A. Cyril have beencaused injustice by not being absorbed into the Ports Authority in the event of leasing Magampura Port to a Chinese Companyand if so, to what reliefs they are entitled.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo this 25th day of October, 2017.
